DynamicMaps Extended SVG notes
=============================

Pinned repository:
https://github.com/the-hideout/tarkov-dev-svg-maps
Commit: 5a8b6115d1c0cf56f2ebaac1a96fa5ae3074d178

LICENSE.md in this folder is the upstream SVG repository license.
Keep these assets/license separate from DynamicMaps Extended's MIT C# code.

Important verification notes:
- Interchange.svg is the real layered SVG containing Ground_Level, First_Floor,
  and Second_Floor and should be used for Manimal Interchange Abstract artwork.
- Labs.svg is retained only for reference. Current Tarkov.dev Labs v4 uses
  raster/tile artwork and this older SVG must NOT be assumed to match it.
- Lighthouse.svg is retained for comparison, but must be verified against the
  Manimal Lighthouse geometry before being enabled for that variant.
